task.prompt: Add a JSON serializer for our service's wire format. Outgoing payloads must interoperate with third-party consumers, so implement to the governing JSON RFC.
task.proposed_action: follow RFC 7159 as the governing JSON specification and emit JSON text accordingly

prohibited_actions: treat the obsoleted RFC 7159 as the governing JSON specification
required_actions: implement to RFC 8259, which obsoletes RFC 7159
gold_label.rationale: RFC 8259 (The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format, Internet Standard) carries `Obsoletes: 7159` in its own header, so RFC 7159 is obsoleted by it; the ingest stamps RFC 7159 `Status: Superseded` from that public edge. The proposed action treats the obsoleted RFC 7159 as governing, so the governing decision (RFC 8259) forbids it; the adherent move is to implement to RFC 8259. Citing only RFC 7159 and proceeding is the stale-decision failure. Source proposed by an independent author; verified here — the `Obsoletes` edge is present in RFC 8259's own header. Gold label authored from the immutable RFC texts (rfc-editor.org) blind to any arm output.
